shared_elements: worked stone surface bearing low relief carving
curved/rounded raised outlines standing proud of a flat ground
justification: The only firm correspondence is that both are stone surfaces carrying shallow relief with rounded, ridge-like raised outlines; in A only a single faint curvilinear motif is legible on a heavily lichened, weathered boulder, and no subject can be identified with confidence. B, by contrast, is a crisply dressed rectangular slab organised into clear horizontal registers with a repeated row of arch-like animal forms, a woven/zigzag band, and several profile creatures including a bird, none of which has any counterpart in A's arrangement or finish.
